comment: Contains signal with accelerator pedal press. Used by fuel cell hydrogen-powered (FCEV) cars such as the 2021 Hyundai Nexo.
E_EMS11: All (plug-in) hybrids use this gas signal: CR_Vcu_AccPedDep_Pos, and all EVs use the Accel_Pedal_Pos signal. See hyundai/values.py for a specific car list
